summary.tagline: A National Nature Reserve renowned for puffin colonies and spectacular spring wildflower displays.
summary.seo_title: Visiting Skomer Island: Puffins and Seabird Colonies

travel.headline: Boat Landing and Hostel Reservations
travel.reservation: Day visits and overnight stays at the sustainably run hostel require advance booking. As an internationally important seabird island, visitor numbers are controlled; check official Welsh Wildlife Trust sites for current boat landing permit systems and availability.

days.title: Seabird Colonies and Coastal Cliffs

stops.name: Skomer
stops.detail: Explore the largest Pembrokeshire island to see Puffins nesting in cliff-top burrows and cliffs packed with Guillemots and Razorbills.

days.driving: Allow for boat transit times; conditions at sea vary significantly.
days.note: Puffins are typically present from May through July, with most departing by the end of July.

intel.title: Mainland Access
intel.text: Evidence does not specify parking capacity at the mainland departure point. Travelers should verify local parking at Martin's Haven before arrival.

intel.title: Island Connectivity
intel.text: Connectivity status on the island is not provided in official sources. Expect limited digital access and plan navigation using physical markers.

intel.title: Supplies and Energy
intel.text: The island features a sustainably run hostel, but fuel stations are not available on-site. Ensure all vehicles are fueled on the mainland prior to reaching the coast.

intel.title: Puffin Seasonal Window
intel.text: Visit between mid-April and mid-July for peak puffin activity. Wildflower displays of blue, pink, and white are most prominent in spring and early summer.

intel.title: Boat Departure
intel.text: Access is strictly by boat from the mainland. Departure schedules are weather-dependent and require confirmation with the ferry operator.

plan.arrival: Arrive at Martin's Haven for boat check-in; collect essential supplies in Marloes or nearby mainland towns as the island offers limited amenities.
plan.vehicle: Personal vehicles must remain on the mainland; the island is explored entirely on foot.
plan.goldenHour: The cliffs of Skomer at dusk offer views of Manx Shearwaters, though exact sunset accessibility depends on hostel residency or boat schedules.
